test_dataframe_reductions: test DataFrame reduction methods including sum, mean, min, max, std, var, and other statistical operations
test_stat_op_calc: test statistical operator calculations on DataFrames with skipna, dtype checking, and date handling
test_idxmin_idxmax: test idxmin and idxmax methods on DataFrames with skipna, axis, and numeric_only parameters
test_any_all_reductions: test any and all boolean reduction methods on DataFrames with mixed types and NA values
test_mode_dropna: test mode method on DataFrames with dropna parameter for various dtypes including categorical and datetime
test_min_max_dt64_nat: test min and max methods on DataFrames containing datetime64 columns with NaT values
test_sum_prod_min_count: test sum and prod methods with min_count parameter on DataFrames with NA values
test_reductions_extension_arrays: test reduction methods on DataFrames with nullable extension array dtypes like Int64 and Float64
test_empty_dataframe_reductions: test reduction operations on empty DataFrames with various dtypes and min_count settings
test_nuisance_columns: test reduction behavior with categorical and non-numeric nuisance columns in DataFrames
